policy: Source snapshots, not inferred construction dates. 1860 remains explicitly a plan through 1919; 1920 denotes a decade. No interpolation of undocumented construction. Derived blocks are street enclosures, not parcels. The building layer retains 1920s roof symbols through the road-only 1942 source until 2013, with explicit uncertainty about continued existence and known demolitions respected. OSM changes may reflect mapping completeness.
interpretation: Manual source-pixel street centre lines and selected roof symbols. Three inherited street-junction controls for each drawn map, not independently surveyed georeferencing. 1942 uses official EPSG:3874 tile coordinates. Widths are cartographic estimates. Block polygons are generated from street enclosures, inset 4 metres; they are not cadastral parcels. No raster artwork is generated or republished by this workflow.
knownLimitations: 1860 remains a plan, not an assertion about built streets in 1861–1919.
Museum date is a whole decade. Simplified roofs are carried through 1942–2013 with unverified survival; separate building data takes over in 2014.
1942 is a selected street inventory, not a full building reconstruction.
Different map sources have alignment differences; line shifts need not mean street relocation.
OSM changes can represent improved mapping as well as physical changes. Modern buildings are not backdated.
buildingLayer: City roofs are now rendered by dist/city-buildings.js. Historical OSM building snapshots and documented place stories are described separately in data/city-building-provenance.json. Street and block source policy is unchanged.

recentStreetAlignment.method: Use canonical 2026 street geometry where at least 85% of a segment lies within 20 metres of a source-year road corridor. Keep substantial older deviations absent from 2026. Derive street blocks from the normalized main street network, excluding paths and service roads.
recentStreetAlignment.limitation: Cartographic continuity assumption requested for the modern city. Not a claim that every road was unchanged, or a construction-date inventory.
